title: Resolvable GRU test (ML-F29): add a paired block-bootstrap statistic to ml_bakeoff so a +0.010 macro_f1 delta is decidable, then author the unit (deep_sequence family)

frontier.baseline: LightGBM on identical purged folds and rows (ff8f-04 design)
frontier.blocking_lever: scripts/research/ml_bakeoff.py has no bootstrap or multi-seed support (grep 2026-11-13: none). Needed: a paired moving-block bootstrap of the row-level macro_f1 delta (block = label horizon) within each test fold, pooled across folds, giving a CI on delta; OR an n_seeds paired design. Then author the unit with power from the measured row-level sd.
frontier.consumer: the 15m regime heads still registered (btc/sol-regime-15m-lgbm-fc-pcv-v2); their v1 siblings were demoted 2026-11-11
frontier.est_cost: lever ~half a day; unit runs on the trainer route
frontier.next_step: lever #25573 merged; unit RQ-20261113-4654-02 in PR #25633 (trainer route); grade when it lands
frontier.source: ML-F29 (needs_authoring, ML-READ-1025): ff8f-04 GRU INDETERMINATE (n 72,000); fold-level macro_f1 delta sd ~0.03 so +0.010 needs ~70 folds
frontier.why: deep_sequence's only open plan item; a resolvable design needs a row-level statistic, not fold-level
